# trending.md — LLM-readable site guide

## Key endpoints

- [JSON Feed](https://trending.md/feed.json) — Structured trending data. **Primary agent endpoint.** Returns 10 items ranked by velocity with title, summary, why_it_matters, tags, source, engagement, benchmarks, links. Updated every 15 min.
- [Markdown Feed](https://trending.md/feed/latest.md) — Same feed in markdown. Human-readable, machine-parseable.
- [About](https://trending.md/about.md) — Project overview and consumption guide.

## Optional

- [Daily Archive](https://trending.md/archive/) — Historical daily snapshots.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/takoyaki-baron/trending-md) — Source code and contribution guide.

## JSON Feed Schema

```json
{
  "feed": "trending.md",
  "version": "1.0",
  "updated": "ISO 8601 timestamp",
  "items": [{
    "rank": "integer 1-10",
    "title": "headline string",
    "velocity": "trending | rising | steady",
    "velocity_score": "0.0-1.0 float",
    "source": {"name": "", "domain": ""},
    "engagement": {"points": 0, "stars": 0, "comments": 0},
    "published": "ISO 8601",
    "tags": ["kebab-case strings"],
    "summary": "1-3 sentence factual summary",
    "why_it_matters": "1 sentence signal interpretation",
    "benchmarks": {"name": "value", ...},
    "links": [{"label": "", "url": ""}]
  }]
}
```

## Ranking

Items ranked by **velocity** (weighted composite):
- Recency — how recently the signal emerged
- Engagement acceleration — how fast attention is growing
- Source authority — weighted by historical reliability

Goal: surface *what's moving now*, not *what has the most total attention*.
